title: docs(skills): elevate startup scope discipline to a first-class fourth axis — all four synced copies of the decision frame at once
body:
Fixes #9791

**Governed surfaces throughout (`.claude/**`, `skills/**`) — DRAFT, human merge only. Never queue, never arm auto-merge, never flip ready.**

## What

Maintainer ruling (2026-08-18, verbatim, untranslated): 「9769 应该是四维度分析,但是还在写三轴。从实际业务需求,从平台长远合理性,从避免AI写代码犯错的角度,从创业阶段不扩散需求的角度。」

The escalation decision frame goes from THREE fixed axes to FOUR first-class axes — 实际业务需求 · 项目长远合理性 · 防 AI 写代码犯错 · 创业阶段不扩散需求 — one-to-one with the four card facets. All four synced copies in one PR, exactly as `check:skill-frame-sync` requires:

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (internal PM copy): **extraction, not rewriting** — 创业阶段聚焦原则 (the 2026-08-04 quote, implementation-first default, zero-consumption/sunk-cost clause) moves out of axis 1 into the new axis 4 「创业阶段不扩散需求」. Counts updated (三条固定评估轴 → 四条; 这三条轴/三轴冲突 → 四条轴/四轴冲突). The 四棱-serialization sentence becomes 「四棱是四条评估轴的卡面序列化,一一对应,同一个框架不是第二套」. Guards-index row: 三轴决策框架 → 四维决策框架.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (internal dev copy): same extraction into a fourth bullet **Startup scope discipline**(创业阶段不扩散需求); counts three → four.
- `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (published, English, both embedded copies): new **Axis ④ — startup scope discipline** in the PM section and a fourth bullet in the embedded dev template, carrying the sunk-cost / implementation-first / conventions-file-stance content moved out of Axis ①; every count mention updated ("the deep three-axis analysis" → four-axis, section header, declaring and binding sentences). The route-B generalization is preserved: the conventions-file delegation stays, no this-repo self-description added.
- `scripts/check-skill-frame-sync.mjs`: the fourth `AXIS_MAP` entry (`startup-scope-discipline`, zh /创业阶段不扩散/, en /startup(?:-phase)? scope discipline/i) — the gate's own failure text mandates recording a new axis there in the same PR. Self-test fixture strings retargeted ONLY where the changed literals made cases red (7 cases: count-vs-entries want, coherent-demotion literals, "both axes" case gains a second demotion to stay a 2-entry specimen, binding/declaring-removed literals, mention-drift literals, misaligned-map case gains `AXIS_MAP[3]`). No logic changed.
- `scripts/check-skill-frame-freshness.mjs`: one self-test want-line retargeted (`2 axes: long-term-soundness` → 3, `3 axes: business-need` → 4); the demotion machinery itself is count-agnostic and untouched.

Not done on purpose: axis 2 keeps its established name 项目长远合理性 — the ruling's 「平台长远合理性」 is chat shorthand also present in the pre-existing 2026-08-12 quote, and the card's enumerated changes do not include an axis-2 rename (flagged in the dev report for the maintainer to confirm).

## Verification (all at final head `87b713e`, after merging origin/main forward)

- `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` (self-test 12 cases + gate): exit 0 — `4 copies … structurally isomorphic across 3 files / 4 axes: business-need → long-term-soundness → ai-authoring-safety → startup-scope-discipline / binding sentence present in all 4; 4 count mention(s) agree; 42 markdown files scanned`.
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` (self-test 12 cases + gate): exit 0 — reports the structural difference vs origin/main as a deliberate LOCAL CHANGE notice, as designed.
- Full derived union (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, no paths — 12 matched gates), each exit 0 at `87b713e`: `check:agent-model-declared` · `check:cross-package-test-inputs` (pnpm + node forms) · `check:doc-authoring` · `check:doc-formula-expressions` · `check:nul-bytes` · `check:pm-governed-merges` · `check:pm-skill-id-lint` · `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (table above) · `check:skill-compatibility` · `check:skill-frame-sync` · `check:skill-frame-freshness`.

Predecessors verified present on the base before editing: the four-facet block with the os-decision-facets marker (merged 00:35Z) and the pipe-capture discipline in os-dev.md (merged 00:26Z).
